candidates.summary: Fully unrolled: entries 1 to 4 straight-line with X known (STA abs instead of abs,X, STX abs for the block number, LDX #k for INX; no SEC, no BRA, no loop, the first test folded into the prelude, no test after entry 4). Superset of candidate 2 (alternatives, not combinable); about 39 bytes bigger than it. Defines no labels.
candidates.equivalence: Same stores in the same order of the same values: for X = 0,1,2,... the original builds entry X+1 from entry X (rl - &80 with the borrow into rh - 2, ORA #&40; rt = 7; rb = X+1; rn = 8 unless it is the last, which .top sets), with the same C chain. Specialising on a known X turns abs,X into abs + k addresses and TXA/STA rb,X into STX abs (same byte stored). At .top the registers are as before: A = the lines left (sky_n, equal to the memory byte, which holds the same value as in the original at that point), X = the last entry, C = 0 (BCC taken, or BCS not taken) though .top does not read C (CMP #8 first); Y untouched (as before); sky_t = L + 1 and sky_rn[0], sky_rb[0] stored as before. The intermediate sky_n = n that the original stored first is a zero-page scratch ($DE, no reader before it is rewritten; the interrupt does not touch &D2-&E6) and now starts at n - 8, which is what the original had after its first (always taken) test. Entry 1 is never the top (n >= 15) and entry 4 always is: n <= 27 means n - 24 <= 3 <= 8, so the original's test after entry 4 would always take BCC top; the test after entry 3 (n - 16 >= 9) decides whether entry 4 exists. So the original's loop runs 2 to 4 times with exactly these outcomes. Entry 4 stores rl+4 etc.: the original writes those too when n >= 25 (SKY_ROWS = 6, spacing &BC90/&BC96/...). Entered by fall-through from the line above only; the exits are BCC top (twice, X = 2 or 3, A = sky_n) and the fall-through into .top (X = 4, A = n - 24 loaded last). No label in the window is referenced outside it except .top (kept); .more was referenced only inside the window (grep).
candidates.relies_on: sky_H is 23, 26 or 28 whenever sky_geom runs (sky_heights; sky_H is stored only at sky.6502 type_ok and restored/loaded from sky_h, which is stored from sky_H only; sky_geom is entered only by JMP from sky.6502 .geom and sky_main.6502 sky_old_geom, the latter only for a helicopter with sky_on set), L is 0-7, so n = H - L - 1 is 15 to 27: the original already relies on H > 8 (its line 48 comment). The carry: C is 1 after SEC; SBC sky_t (no borrow, H >= L + 1), and after every SBC #&02 in the loop (the high byte read is always &40-&7F: sky_rh is set by AND #&3F; ORA #&40 and by ORA #&40 in the loop, so rh - 2 - borrow >= &3D never borrows); ORA, LDX, LDA, STA, STX leave C; CMP #9 not taken leaves C = 1 for SBC #8. Entries 1 and 2 are never the last, and entry 4 always is, from that range of n (sky_heights max 28). Page crossings: hazel_b_end moves DF65 -> DFCC (E000 ASSERT leaves 52 bytes); everything after the window slides up 0x67: the split loop (was DEC2-DF1B, straddling DE/DF; its BNE split, BNE whole and BCC whole each paid +1 when taken across) now lies wholly in page DF, sky_col_row/sky_col_check stay inside page DF (DF86-DFCC); no branch is made to cross. Measured by pcprof on the unshifted DEBUG_LIVES build (the bench), seed 1, 1500 passes from 500: sky_geom (DE2C to its RTS) 344.2 -> 304.2 cycles a pass (-40.0, of which about -28 in the window and the rest the split loop's lost crossings). passlock seed 3, 4000 passes with --screen: identical; helilock: identical.

candidates.summary: No assumption beyond the original's (H > 8): SEC dropped from the loop (C is already 1), and the loop rotated so the test at the foot branches back (BCS) instead of BCC-not-taken plus BRA, with one BRA to enter. One byte smaller. The conservative alternative to candidates 1-3 if their sky_heights reasoning is refused; defines skyg_d_next and skyg_d_body.
candidates.equivalence: The same stores as the original in the same order for every n: the original's loop body, test and the block SBC #8; STA sky_n; LDA #8; STA sky_rn,X are the same instructions, laid out as: BRA to the body; the block; the body; at the foot BCS back to the block (original: BCC .top, the block, BRA more). Falling out of BCS (A < 9, C = 0) reaches .top with the same A, X and C (0) as BCC top. The SEC is gone: C = 1 on first entry from SEC; SBC sky_t (H >= L + 1, the original's H > 8), BRA and LDX leave C; on every later pass C = 1 from the previous SBC #&02 (high byte &40-&7F, no borrow) and from CMP #9 not taken (A >= 9). sky_n stored before the loop as before. .more was referenced only inside the window (grep).

Page crossings: BRA and BCS skyg_d_next stay in page DE; code after the window moves down 1 byte: the split loop's crossings (BNE split, BNE whole, BCC whole) are the same as before; sky_col_row DF1F -> DF1E, still wholly in DF. Measured: sky_geom 344.2 -> 337.8 cycles a pass (-6.4); passlock seed 1 3000 passes --screen identical; helilock identical.
